request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the one large numeral described: no other signs, buttons, plaques, door numbers or license plates show any digit.

There are no people anywhere in the photo, not even far in the background or inside the vehicles.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

A bright open-plan office seen from its small elevator lobby: the closed metal elevator door on the left, and beyond a glass wall rows of identical white desks with black office chairs and switched-off computer screens, big windows behind them. On the plain light wall next to the elevator door there is one very large dark numeral 10, painted on the wall, sharp and easy to read on a phone, inside the central 55 percent of the photo width. Nobody is in the office.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
